ko.title: 한 번의 접종, 6개월, 10개국: 세계 최고의 HIV 예방약이 필요한 모든 사람에게 도달하지 못하는 이유

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## 획기적인 약물, 익숙한 병목 현상

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: 수십 년 동안 HIV 예방은 일일 약물, 정기적인 클리닉 방문, 그리고 쉽게 중단할 수 있는 일상적인 루틴을 의미했다.

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: Gilead Sciences가 개발한 2년마다 한 번注射하는 Lenacapavir은 이러한 모든 것을 바꿔야 했다.

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: 1년에 2번의 접종, 임상 시험에서 거의 완전한 보호, 그리고 공중 보건 연구자들이 한 세대에서 HIV 예방의 가장 중요한 발전 중 하나라고 부르는 수준의 편리함.

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: 문제는 과학이 아니다.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: 그것은 약물을 팔에 넣는 것이다.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## Gilead가 약속한 것

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: 전 세계적인 건강 옹호자들의 압력과 국제 건강 기관과의 협력을 통해 Gilead는 Lenacapavir을 이익 없이 낮은 소득 국가에 공급하기로 동의했다. 특히 아프리카의 일부 지역에서 HIV 발병률이 가장 높은 국가들이다.

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: 회사는 또한 규제 승인과 생산 능력이 따라잡을 때 더广泛한 분배를 위해 제네릭 제조업체에 저렴한 버전을 생산하도록 라이센스를 부여했다.

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: 이론적으로 이것은 제네릭 경쟁이 문제를 강요하기 전에 공중 보건 필요에 따라 가격을 조정하기 위해 신속하게 움직이는 제약 회사의 드문 예였다.

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## 어디에서 론칭이 중단되는가

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: 실제로 초기 배포에 참여한 임상가와 건강 관리직은 그림이 불균일하다고 말했다.

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: 참여 국가의 일부 클리닉은 주사를 보유하고 있고 환자를 등록할 준비가 되었다고 보고 있다.

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: 다른 사람들은 11월 말까지 배송을 기대하라는 말을 듣고 있으며, 제공자는 환자에게 확定的 시간표를 줄 수 없으며, 경우에 따라서는 환자를 완전히 중단할 수 없다.

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: 보건 근로자들은真正로 새로운 유형의 주사를 위한 제한된 글로벌 생산 능력, 국가마다 다른 속도로 움직이는 규제 승인 과정, 그리고 매우 다른 수준의 인프라를 갖춘 건강 시스템을 통해 감온성 제품을 배포하는 논리적인 복잡성을 설명한다.

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: 이러한 문제는 글로벌 약물 론칭에서 드문 문제가 아니지만, 시험 데이터가 HIV 감염의 궤적을 의미있게 구부릴 수 있는 약물에 대한 예상과 충돌하고 있다.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## 타이밍이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: 공중 보건 옹호자들은 지연이 중립적이지 않다고 지적한다.

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: 클리닉이 공급 없이 가는 매월은 일일 약물에 의존하는 사람들이 예방을 시작하지 않고頼る 월마다 된다.

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: 국제 건강 기관은 초기 론칭이 HIV에 가장 영향을받는 국가와 인구에게 가능한 한 빠르게 도달하기를 원하고, 초기에 잘 타겟팅된 접근이 시간이 지남에 따라 전염에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 주장했다.

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: Gilead와その 배포 파트너는 일반적으로 첫 번째 제품의 생산과 물류를 확대하는 데 시간이 걸리고, 향후 몇 개월 동안 국가 간의 격차를 메우기 위한 확장 계획을 지적했다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: Lenacapavir의 론칭은 공중 보건 이야기로서뿐만 아니라 낮은 소득 시장에서 무이익 가격에 대한 회사의 약속에 따라 산업이 얼마나 빠르게 움직일 수 있는지 테스트 케이스로 주목을 받고 있다.

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: 공급망이 향후 몇 개월 안에 매끄럽게 진행된다면 옹호자들은 미래의 약물 론칭을 위한 모델이 될 수 있다고 말했다.

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: 격차가 내년까지 지속된다면, 약물이 이론적으로는 이용 가능하지만 실제로는 이용할 수 없게 되는 또 다른 예가 될 위험이 있다.

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: 현재,答案은 클리닉마다 다를 수 있다.

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: 적격 국가의 일부 환자는 이번 달에 Lenacapavir에 대한 예약을 할 수 있다.

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: 다른 사람들은 새로운 해가 끝나기 전에 확인하라고 요청받고 있으며, 공급이 과학을 따라잡기를 희망한다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반 정보 제공을 위한 것으로서 의료 조언을 구성하지 않는다.

segments.src: Readers with questions about HIV prevention options should consult a qualified healthcare provider.*
segments.tr: HIV 예방 옵션에 대한 질문이 있는 독자는 자격을 갖춘 의료 제공자와 상담해야 한다.*

zh.title: 一次注射，六个月，十个国家：为什么世界上最好的HIV预防药物无法覆盖所有需要的人

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## 一种突破性的药物遇到了一个熟悉的瓶颈

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: 几十年来，HIV预防意味着每天服用药片，定期访问诊所，并且容易陷入一种日常生活中。

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: 吉利德科学公司开发的两年一次的注射性药物Lenacapavir本应改变这种情况。

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: 每年两次注射，在临床试验中几乎完全受到保护，并且具有公共卫生研究人员所说的最重要的进展之一。

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: 问题不在于科学。

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: 它是如何将药物注入人们的身体中。

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## 吉利德公司的承诺

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: 在全球健康倡导者和国际卫生组织的压力下，吉利德公司同意以无利可图的方式向一组低收入和中等收入国家提供Lenacapavir，特别是在撒哈拉以南非洲的部分地区。

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: 该公司还授权通用制造商生产更低成本的版本，以便更广泛地分销，一旦监管审批和生产能力赶上。

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: 在纸面上，这是一个罕见的例子，制药公司迅速地使价格与公共卫生需求相符，而不是等待多年让通用竞争迫使问题解决。

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## 推广计划的停滞

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: 在实践中，根据参与早期分配的临床医生和卫生官员的说法，情况很不均衡。

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: 一些诊所报告说，他们的货架上有注射性药物，并准备好为患者提供服务。

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: 其他人说，他们被告知要等到11月份才会收到货物，这使得提供者无法为患者提供明确的时间表，并且在某些情况下，无法开始为新患者提供药物。

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: 卫生工作者描述了一系列原因：真正新型注射性药物的全球制造能力有限，监管审批流程在各个国家以不同的速度进行，以及在具有不同基础设施水平的卫生系统中分发对温度敏感的产品的后勤复杂性。

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: 这些都不是全球药物推广中的罕见问题——但它们与对一种可能从根本上改变新HIV感染轨迹的药物的期望相碰撞。

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么时间很重要

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: 公共卫生倡导者指出，延迟并非中立的。

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: 每个月诊所没有供应的时间就是人们可能开始预防而不是依赖每天服用药片的时间，这对很多人来说很难长期坚持下去。

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: 国际卫生组织一直强调希望最初的推广能够尽快地覆盖最受HIV影响的国家和人群，认为早期、有针对性的获取可以对传播产生不成比例的影响。

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: 吉利德公司及其分销合作伙伴通常承认，扩大制造和物流对于一种开创性的产品需要时间，并指出扩张计划旨在未来几个月内弥合国家之间的差距。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更大的背景

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: Lenacapavir的推广不仅被视为公共卫生故事，也被视为测试行业如何快速行动，当一家公司致力于在低收入市场中无利可图地定价时。

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: 如果供应链在未来几个月内变得顺畅，倡导者说，它可以成为未来的药物推广的典范。

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: 如果差距持续到明年，它可能会成为另一个医疗突破的例子——在理论上可以获得，但在实践中要等待很长时间。

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: 目前，答案可能因诊所而异。

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: 一些患者在合格的国家可以预约Lenacapavir。

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: 其他人被要求在新年开始后检查是否有货，这样他们就可以在供应赶上科学之前开始使用药物。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息，不构成医疗建议。*

segments.src: Readers with questions about HIV prevention options should consult a qualified healthcare provider.*
segments.tr: 有关HIV预防选项的读者应咨询合格的医疗保健提供者。*

segments.tr: ## एक सफलता प्राप्त दवा एक जानी-पहचानी बाधा का सामना करती है

segments.tr: द दशकों से, एचआईवी की रोकथाम का मतलब दैनिक गोलियां, नियमित क्लिनिक जाना और उस तरह की दिनचर्या रहा है जिससे पीछे हटना आसान है।

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: साल में दो शॉट, नैदानिक ​​परीक्षणों में लगभग-पूर्ण सुरक्षा, और एक ऐसी सुविधा का स्तर जिसे सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य शोधकर्ताओं ने एक पीढ़ी में एचआईवी रोकथाम में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण प्रगति में से एक कहा है।

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## गिलेड ने क्या वादा किया था

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: वैश्विक स्वास्थ्य अधिवक्ताओं के दबाव में और अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य संगठनों के साथ साझेदारी में, गिलेड कम और मध्यम आय वाले देशों के एक समूह को बिना मुनाफे के लेनाकपावीर की आपूर्ति करने के लिए सहमत हुआ, जहाँ एचआईवी की दरें सबसे अधिक बनी हुई हैं, विशेष रूप से उप-सहारा अफ्रीका के कुछ हिस्सों में।

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: कंपनी ने नियामक स्वीकृतियों और उत्पादन क्षमता के पूरा होने के बाद व्यापक वितरण के लिए कम लागत वाले संस्करणों का उत्पादन करने के लिए जेनेरिक निर्माताओं को भी लाइसेंस दिया।

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: कागजों पर, यह एक दवा कंपनी का एक दुर्लभ उदाहरण था जो जेनेरिक प्रतियोगिता द्वारा इस मुद्दे को मजबूर करने के लिए वर्षों इंतजार करने के बजाय सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य की जरूरत के साथ मूल्य निर्धारण को संरेखित करने के लिए तेजी से आगे बढ़ रही थी।

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## रोलआउट कहाँ रुक रहा है

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, शुरुआती वितरण में शामिल चिकित्सकों और स्वास्थ्य अधिकारियों के अनुसार, तस्वीर असमान रही है।

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: भाग लेने वाले देशों के कुछ क्लीनिकों ने रिपोर्ट दी है कि उनकी अलमारियां इंजेक्टेबल से भरी हुई हैं और रोगियों को नामांकित करने के लिए तैयार हैं।

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: अन्य का कहना है कि उन्हें नवंबर जितनी देर से शिपमेंट की उम्मीद करने के लिए कहा गया है, जिससे प्रदाता रोगियों को एक निश्चित समय सीमा देने में असमर्थ हैं और कुछ मामलों में, नए रोगियों को दवा पर शुरू करने में पूरी तरह से असमर्थ हैं।

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य कार्यकर्ता कारणों के मिश्रण का वर्णन करते हैं: वास्तव में एक नए प्रकार के इंजेक्टेबल के लिए सीमित वैश्विक विनिर्माण क्षमता, नियामक अनुमोदन प्रक्रियाएं जो देश से देश में अलग-अलग गति से चलती हैं, और बहुत अलग स्तर के बुनियादी ढांचे वाले स्वास्थ्य प्रणालियों में तापमान के प्रति संवेदनशील उत्पाद को वितरित करने की तार्किक जटिलता।

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: इनमें से कोई भी वैश्विक दवा रोलआउट में असामान्य समस्याएं नहीं हैं - लेकिन वे एक ऐसी दवा के लिए असामान्य रूप से उच्च उम्मीदों से टकरा रही हैं जो परीक्षण डेटा से पता चलता है कि नए एचआईवी संक्रमणों के प्रक्षेपवक्र को सार्थक रूप से मोड़ सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## समय क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य अधिवक्ता ध्यान देते हैं कि देरी तटस्थ नहीं है।

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: जिस महीने कोई क्लिनिक बिना आपूर्ति के रहता है, वह एक ऐसा महीना होता है जहाँ जिन लोगों ने रोकथाम शुरू की होगी, वे इसके बिना रहते हैं, दैनिक गोलियों पर भरोसा करते हैं जो प्रभावी हैं लेकिन लंबे समय तक कई लोगों के लिए बनाए रखना कठिन है।

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य संगठन शुरुआती रोलआउट को उन देशों और आबादी तक पहुँचाने के बारे में मुखर रहे हैं जो एचआईवी से सबसे अधिक प्रभावित हैं, यह तर्क देते हुए कि शुरुआती, अच्छी तरह से लक्षित पहुंच समय के साथ संचरण पर भारी प्रभाव डाल सकती है।

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: गिलेड और उसके वितरण भागीदारों ने आम तौर पर स्वीकार किया है कि एक अपनी तरह के पहले उत्पाद के लिए विनिर्माण और रसद को बढ़ाना समय लेता है, और आने वाले महीनों में देशों के बीच अंतराल को पाटने के उद्देश्य से विस्तार योजनाओं की ओर इशारा किया है।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: लेनाकपावीर के रोलआउट को न केवल एक सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य कहानी के रूप में बल्कि इस बात के परीक्षण के मामले के रूप में बारीकी से देखा जा रहा है कि जब कोई कंपनी कम आय वाले बाजारों में बिना लाभ के मूल्य निर्धारण के लिए प्रतिबद्ध होती है तो उद्योग कितनी तेजी से आगे बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: अ अधिवक्ताओं का कहना है कि अगर आने वाले महीनों में आपूर्ति श्रृंखला सुचारू हो जाती है, तो यह भविष्य के दवा लॉन्च के लिए एक मॉडल बन सकता है।

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: यदि अंतराल अगले वर्ष तक बने रहते हैं, तो यह एक आशाजनक चिकित्सा सफलता के असमान रूप से आने का एक और उदाहरण बनने का जोखिम उठाता है - सिद्धांत में लंबे समय तक उपलब्ध होने से पहले यह अभ्यास में उपलब्ध हो जाता है।

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, उत्तर संभवतः क्लिनिक दर क्लिनिक भिन्न होता है।

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: पात्र देशों के कुछ मरीज इस महीने लेनाकपावीर के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं।

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: अन्य लोगों को नए साल के अपने अंतिम चरण में प्रवेश करने के बाद वापस जाँचने के लिए कहा जा रहा है, यह उम्मीद करते हुए कि आपूर्ति विज्ञान के साथ पकड़ बना लेगी।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और इसमें चिकित्सा सलाह शामिल नहीं है।

segments.src: Readers with questions about HIV prevention options should consult a qualified healthcare provider.*
segments.tr: एचआईवी रोकथाम के विकल्पों के बारे में प्रश्न वाले पाठकों को एक योग्य स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदाता से परामर्श करना चाहिए।*

es.title: Una dosis, seis meses, diez países: por qué el mejor medicamento para la prevención del VIH del mundo no llega a todos los que lo necesitan

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## Un fármaco innovador se encuentra con un cuello de botella familiar

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: Durante décadas, la prevención del VIH ha significado pastillas diarias, visitas regulares a la clínica y el tipo de rutina que es fácil de abandonar.

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: El lenacapavir, el inyectable semestral desarrollado por Gilead Sciences, debía cambiar esa ecuación por completo.

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: Dos inyecciones al año, protección casi total en ensayos clínicos y un nivel de comodidad que los investigadores de salud pública han calificado como uno de los avances más significativos en la prevención del VIH en una generación.

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: El problema no es la ciencia.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: Es lograr que el medicamento llegue a los brazos.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## Lo que prometió Gilead

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: Bajo la presión de los defensores de la salud mundial y en asociación con organizaciones sanitarias internacionales, Gilead acordó suministrar lenacapavir sin fines de lucro a un grupo de países de ingresos bajos y medianos donde las tasas de VIH siguen siendo más altas, particularmente en partes del África subsahariana.

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: La compañía también otorgó licencias a fabricantes de genéricos para producir versiones de menor costo para una distribución más amplia una vez que las aprobaciones regulatorias y la capacidad de producción se pongan al día.

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: Sobre el papel, fue un ejemplo raro de una empresa farmacéutica que actuó rápidamente para alinear los precios con las necesidades de salud pública en lugar de esperar años a que la competencia de genéricos forzara el problema.

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## Dónde se está estancando el despliegue

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: En la práctica, según los médicos y funcionarios de salud involucrados en la distribución inicial, el panorama ha sido desigual.

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: Algunas clínicas en los países participantes informan que tienen los estantes abastecidos con el inyectable y listas para inscribir pacientes.

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: Otras dicen que se les ha dicho que esperen envíos recién en noviembre, lo que deja a los proveedores sin poder dar a los pacientes un cronograma firme y, en algunos casos, sin poder iniciar a nuevos pacientes con el medicamento en absoluto.

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: Los trabajadores de la salud describen una mezcla de causas: capacidad de fabricación global limitada para un tipo de inyectable genuinamente nuevo, procesos de aprobación regulatoria que avanzan a diferentes velocidades de un país a otro y la complejidad logística de distribuir un producto sensible a la temperatura en sistemas de salud con niveles de infraestructura muy diferentes.

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: Ninguno de estos son problemas inusuales en los despliegues mundiales de medicamentos, pero están chocando con expectativas inusualmente altas para un medicamento que los datos de los ensayos sugirieron que podría cambiar significativamente la trayectoria de las nuevas infecciones por VIH.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa el momento

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: Los defensores de la salud pública señalan que los retrasos no son neutrales.

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: Cada mes que una clínica pasa sin suministro es un mes en el que las personas que podrían haber comenzado la prevención se quedan sin ella, dependiendo de pastillas diarias que son efectivas pero más difíciles de mantener para muchas personas durante largos períodos.

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: Las organizaciones internacionales de salud han expresado abiertamente su deseo de que el despliegue inicial llegue a los países y poblaciones más afectados por el VIH lo más rápido posible, argumentando que el acceso temprano y bien focalizado puede tener efectos descomunales en la transmisión con el tiempo.

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: Gilead y sus socios de distribución han reconocido en general que ampliar la fabricación y la logística para un producto único en su tipo lleva tiempo, y han señalado planes de expansión destinados a cerrar las brechas entre los países en los próximos meses.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: El despliegue del lenacapavir se sigue de cerca no solo como una historia de salud pública, sino como una prueba de fuego sobre la rapidez con la que la industria puede moverse cuando una empresa se compromete a fijar precios sin fines de lucro en mercados de menores ingresos.

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: Si la cadena de suministro se estabiliza en los próximos meses, los defensores dicen que podría convertirse en un modelo para futuros lanzamientos de medicamentos.

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: Si las brechas persisten hasta el próximo año, corre el riesgo de convertirse en otro ejemplo de un avance médico prometedor que llega de manera desigual: disponible en teoría mucho antes de estar disponible en la práctica.

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la respuesta probablemente varíe clínica por clínica.

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: Algunos pacientes en países elegibles pueden programar una cita para el lenacapavir este mes.

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: A otros se les pide que vuelvan a consultar después de que el nuevo año comience su recta final, con la esperanza de que el suministro alcance a la ciencia.

segments.tr: *Este artículo es para fines informativos generales y no constituye consejo médico.

segments.tr: Los lectores con preguntas sobre las opciones de prevención del VIH deben consultar a un proveedor de atención médica calificado.*

ar.title: حقنة واحدة، ستة أشهر، عشر دول: لماذا لا يصل أفضل دواء في العالم للوقاية من فيروس نقص المناعة البشرية إلى كل من يحتاجه

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## اختراق دوائي يواجه عقبة مألوفة

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: لعقود طويلة، كان الوقاية من فيروس نقص المناعة البشرية تعني تناول حبوب يومية، وزيارات منتظمة للعيادات، ونمطاً من الروتين يصعب الالتزام به.

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: كان من المفترض أن يغير عقار ليناكابافير، وهو حقنة تؤخذ مرتين سنوياً طورتها شركة غيلياد ساينسز، هذه المعادلة بالكامل.

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: حقنتان في السنة، وحماية شبه كاملة في التجارب السريرية، ومستوى من الراحة وصفه باحثو الصحة العامة بأنه أحد أهم الإنجازات في الوقاية من فيروس نقص المناعة البشرية منذ جيل كامل.

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: المشكلة ليست في العلم نفسه.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: بل في إيصال الدواء إلى الأيدي.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## ما وعدت به غيلياد

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: تحت ضغط من دعاة الصحة العالمية وبالشراكة مع منظمات الصحة الدولية، وافقت شركة غيلياد على توفير عقار ليناكابافير بدون تحقيق أرباح لمجموعة من البلدان منخفضة ومتوسطة الدخل حيث تظل معدلات الإصابة بفيروس نقص المناعة البشرية في أعلى مستوياتها، لا سيما في أجزاء من إفريقيا جنوب الصحراء الكبرى.

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: كما منحت الشركة ترخيصاً لمصنعي الأدوية الجنيسة لإنتاج نسخ أقل تكلفة لتوزيعها على نطاق أوسع بمجرد الحصول على الموافقات التنظيمية وتوفر القدرة الإنتاجية.

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: على الورق، كان هذا مثالاً نادراً لشركة أدوية تحركت بسرعة لمواءمة الأسعار مع الاحتياجات الصحية العامة بدلاً من انتظار سنوات حتى تفرض المنافسة العامة هذا الأمر.

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## أين تعثر عملية طرح الدواء

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: في الواقع، ووفقاً للأطباء ومسؤولي الصحة المشاركين في التوزيع المبكر، كانت الصورة غير متساوية.

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: تفيد بعض العيادات في البلدان المشاركة بأن أرففها ممتلئة بالحقن وجاهزة لتسجيل المرضى.

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: بينما تقول أخرى إنها أُبلغت بتوقع وصول الشحنات في موعد لا يتجاوز نوفمبر، مما جعل مقدمي الرعاية عاجزين عن إعطاء المرضى جدولاً زمنياً ثابتاً، وفي بعض الحالات، عاجزين تماماً عن بدء علاج مرضى جدد بهذا الدواء.

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: يصف العاملون في مجال الصحة مجموعة من الأسباب: القدرة المحدودة للتصنيع العالمي لنوع جديد حقاً من الحقن، وعمليات الموافقة التنظيمية التي تسير بسرعات مختلفة من دولة إلى أخرى، وتعقيد الخدمات اللوجستية لتوزيع منتج حساس للحرارة عبر أنظمة صحية ذات مستويات مختلفة جداً من البنية التحتية.

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: ليست أي من هذه المشكلات غريبة في عمليات طرح الأدوية العالمية، لكنها تتصادم مع توقعات عالية بشكل غير معتاد لدواء أشارت بيانات التجارب إلى أنه يمكن أن يغير بشكل كبير مسار الإصابات الجديدة بفيروس نقص المناعة البشرية.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا التوقيت مهم

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: يشير دعاة الصحة العامة إلى أن التأخير ليس أمراً محايداً.

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: فكل شهر تمر به عيادة بدون إمدادات هو شهر يعيش فيه الأشخاص الذين كان يمكنهم بدء الوقاية محرومين منها، معتمدين على الحبوب اليومية التي تكون فعالة ولكن يصعب على الكثيرين الاستمرار عليها لفترات طويلة.

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: كانت منظمات الصحة الدولية واضحة في رغبتها في أن يصل الطرح الأولي إلى البلدان والفئات الأكثر تضرراً من فيروس نقص المناعة البشرية بأسرع وقت ممكن، محذرة من أن الوصول المبكر والموجه بدقة يمكن أن يكون له تأثيرات هائلة على انتقال العدوى بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: أقرّت شركة غيلياد وشركاؤها في التوزيع عموماً بأن توسيع نطاق التصنيع والخدمات اللوجستية لمنتج فريد من نوعه يستغرق وقتاً، وأشاروا إلى خطط التوسع التي تهدف إلى سد الفجوات بين البلدان في الأشهر المقبلة.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## الصورة الأكبر

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: تتم متابعة طرح عقار ليناكابافير عن كثب ليس فقط كقصة صحة عامة، بل كحالة اختبار لمدى سرعة تحرك الصناعة عندما تلتزم الشركة بتسعير خالٍ من الأرباح في الأسواق منخفضة الدخل.

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: إذا استقرت سلسلة التوريد في الأشهر المقبلة، يقول الدعاة إنها قد تصبح نموذجاً لإطلاق الأدوية في المستقبل.

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: وإذا استمرت الفجوات حتى العام المقبل، فإنها تخاطر بأن تصبح مثالاً آخر على إنجاز طبي واعد يصل بشكل غير متساوٍ، فهو متاح نظرياً قبل فترة طويلة من توفره عملياً.

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، من المرجح أن تختلف الإجابة من عيادة إلى أخرى.

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: يمكن لبعض المرضى في البلدان المؤهلة الحصول على موعد لحقن ليناكابافير هذا الشهر.

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: بينما يُطلب من آخرين المراجعة بعد دخول العام الجديد مرحلته الأخيرة، على أمل أن يلحق الإمداد بالجانب العلمي.

fr.title: Un seul tir, six mois, dix pays : pourquoi le meilleur médicament de prévention du VIH au monde n'atteint pas tout le monde qui en a besoin

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## Un médicament révolutionnaire rencontre un goulet d'étranglement familier

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: Pendant des décennies, la prévention du VIH a signifié des pilules quotidiennes, des visites régulières dans des cliniques et une routine qui est facile à abandonner.

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: Le lenacapavir, l'injectable bisannuel développé par Gilead Sciences, était censé changer complètement cette donne.

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: Deux injections par an, une protection quasi complète dans les essais cliniques, et un niveau de commodité que les chercheurs en santé publique ont qualifié de l'une des avancées les plus significatives dans la prévention du VIH en une génération.

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: Le problème n'est pas la science.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: C'est obtenir le médicament dans les bras.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## Ce que Gilead a promis

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: Sous la pression des défenseurs de la santé mondiale et en partenariat avec des organisations de santé internationales, Gilead a accepté de fournir du lenacapavir sans profit à un groupe de pays à revenu faible et moyen où les taux de VIH restent les plus élevés, en particulier dans certaines parties de l'Afrique subsaharienne.

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: L'entreprise a également accordé une licence à des fabricants génériques pour produire des versions à faible coût pour une distribution plus large une fois que les approbations réglementaires et la capacité de production rattraperont leur retard.

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: Sur le papier, il s'agissait d'un exemple rare d'une entreprise pharmaceutique qui agissait rapidement pour aligner les prix sur les besoins de santé publique plutôt que d'attendre des années que la concurrence générique force la question.

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## Où le déploiement est en panne

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: Dans la pratique, selon les cliniciens et les responsables de la santé impliqués dans la distribution initiale, le tableau est inégal.

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: Certaines cliniques dans les pays participants signalent des étagères approvisionnées avec l'injectable et prêtes à inscrire des patients.

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: D'autres déclarent qu'on leur a dit de s'attendre à des livraisons seulement à la fin novembre, laissant les prestataires incapables de donner aux patients un calendrier ferme et, dans certains cas, incapables de commencer de nouveaux patients sous le médicament du tout.

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: Les travailleurs de la santé décrivent un mélange de causes : une capacité de fabrication mondiale limitée pour un type d'injectable vraiment nouveau, des processus d'approbation réglementaire qui se déroulent à des vitesses différentes d'un pays à l'autre, et la complexité logistique de la distribution d'un produit sensible à la température à travers des systèmes de santé aux niveaux d'infrastructure très différents.

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: Aucun de ces problèmes n'est inhabituel dans les déploiements de médicaments mondiaux — mais ils entrent en collision avec des attentes inhabituellement élevées pour un médicament dont les données d'essai suggèrent qu'il pourrait significativement infléchir la trajectoire des nouvelles infections à VIH.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le timing est important

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs de la santé publique notent que les retards ne sont pas neutres.

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: Chaque mois où une clinique se passe de fournitures est un mois où les personnes qui auraient pu commencer une prévention se passent de celle-ci, en s'appuyant sur des pilules quotidiennes qui sont efficaces mais plus difficiles à maintenir pour de nombreuses personnes sur de longues périodes.

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: Les organisations de santé internationales ont été vocales sur le fait qu'ils veulent que le déploiement initial atteigne les pays et les populations les plus touchés par le VIH le plus rapidement possible, en faisant valoir que l'accès précoce et ciblé peut avoir des effets démesurés sur la transmission avec le temps.

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: Gilead et ses partenaires de distribution ont généralement reconnu que la mise à l'échelle de la fabrication et de la logistique pour un produit sans précédent prend du temps, et ont pointé des plans d'expansion destinés à combler les écarts entre les pays dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Le tableau plus large

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: Le déploiement du lenacapavir est étroitement surveillé non seulement en tant qu'histoire de santé publique mais en tant que test pour savoir à quelle vitesse l'industrie peut bouger lorsqu'une entreprise s'engage à des prix sans profit sur les marchés à faible revenu.

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: Si la chaîne d'approvisionnement se fluidifie dans les prochains mois, les défenseurs disent qu'il pourrait devenir un modèle pour les lancements de médicaments futurs.

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: Si les lacunes persistent jusqu'à l'année prochaine, il risque de devenir un autre exemple d'une avancée médicale prometteuse qui arrive de manière inégale — disponible en théorie longtemps avant d'être disponible dans la pratique.

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la réponse varie probablement d'une clinique à l'autre.

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: Certains patients dans les pays éligibles peuvent obtenir un rendez-vous pour du lenacapavir ce mois-ci.

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: D'autres sont invités à vérifier après le début de la nouvelle année, en espérant que la fourniture rattrape la science.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article est à des fins d'information générale et ne constitue pas un conseil médical.

segments.src: Readers with questions about HIV prevention options should consult a qualified healthcare provider.*
segments.tr: Les lecteurs ayant des questions sur les options de prévention du VIH devraient consulter un fournisseur de soins de santé qualifié.*

pt.title: Uma Dose, Seis Meses, Dez Países: Por Que o Melhor Medicamento de Prevenção ao HIV do Mundo Não Está Chegando a Todos Que Precisam

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## Um Medicamento Revolucionário Encontra um Gargalo Conhecido

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: Por décadas, a prevenção do HIV significou pílulas diárias, visitas regulares à clínica e o tipo de rotina que é fácil de abandonar.

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: O lenacapavir, o injetável semestral desenvolvido pela Gilead Sciences, deveria mudar completamente essa matemática.

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: Duas doses por ano, proteção quase total em ensaios clínicos e um nível de conveniência que pesquisadores de saúde pública chamaram de um dos avanços mais significativos na prevenção do HIV em uma geração.

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## O Que a Gilead Prometeu

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: Sob pressão de defensores da saúde global e em parceria com organizações internacionais de saúde, a Gilead concordou em fornecer lenacapavir sem lucro para um grupo de países de baixa e média renda onde as taxas de HIV continuam mais altas, particularmente em partes da África Subsariana.

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: A empresa também licenciou fabricantes de genéricos para produzir versões de menor custo para distribuição mais ampla assim que as aprovações regulatórias e a capacidade de produção alcançarem a demanda.

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: No papel, foi um exemplo raro de uma empresa farmacêutica agindo rapidamente para alinhar os preços às necessidades de saúde pública, em vez de esperar anos até que a concorrência de genéricos forçasse a questão.

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## Onde a Distribuição Está Estagnando

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: Na prática, de acordo com médicos e autoridades de saúde envolvidos na distribuição inicial, o cenário tem sido desigual.

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: Algumas clínicas nos países participantes relatam prateleiras abastecidas com o injetável e prontas para cadastrar pacientes.

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: Outras dizem que foram orientadas a esperar remessas apenas lá para novembro, deixando os profissionais incapazes de dar aos pacientes um cronograma firme e, em alguns casos, incapazes de iniciar novos pacientes com o medicamento.

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: Os profissionais de saúde descrevem uma mistura de causas: capacidade limitada de fabricação global para um tipo genuinamente novo de injetável, processos de aprovação regulatória que avançam em velocidades diferentes de país para país, e a complexidade logística de distribuir um produto sensível à temperatura em sistemas de saúde com níveis muito diferentes de infraestrutura.

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: Nada disso são problemas incomuns em distribuições globais de medicamentos — mas eles estão colidindo com expectativas excepcionalmente altas para um medicamento que os dados dos ensaios sugeriram que poderia mudar significativamente a trajetória de novas infecções por HIV.

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: Organizações internacionais de saúde têm manifestado o desejo de que a distribuição inicial alcance os países e populações mais afetados pelo HIV o mais rápido possível, argumentando que o acesso precoce e bem direcionado pode ter efeitos desproporcionais na transmissão ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.

in.title: Satu Suntikan, Enam Bulan, Sepuluh Negara: Mengapa Obat Pencegahan HIV Terbaik di Dunia Belum Menjangkau Semua yang Membutuhkannya

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## Terobosan Obat Menghadapi Hambatan yang Tak Asing

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa dekade, pencegahan HIV berarti pil harian, kunjungan rutin ke klinik, dan rutinitas yang mudah ditinggalkan.

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: Lenacapavir, suntikan dua kali setahun yang dikembangkan oleh Gilead Sciences, seharusnya mengubah perhitungan tersebut sepenuhnya.

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: Dua suntikan setahun, perlindungan yang hampir lengkap dalam uji klinis, dan tingkat kenyamanan yang disebut oleh para peneliti kesehatan masyarakat sebagai salah satu kemajuan paling signifikan dalam pencegahan HIV dalam satu generasi.

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: Masalahnya bukan pada sainsnya.

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: Masalahnya adalah menyalurkan obat tersebut ke tangan pasien.

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dijanjikan Gilead

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: Di bawah tekanan dari para advokat kesehatan global dan dalam kemitraan dengan organisasi kesehatan internasional, Gilead setuju untuk memasok lenacapavir tanpa keuntungan ke sekelompok negara berpenghasilan rendah dan menengah di mana tingkat HIV tetap tertinggi, terutama di sebagian wilayah Afrika sub-Sahara.

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: Perusahaan juga melisensikan produsen generik untuk memproduksi versi berbiaya lebih rendah untuk distribusi yang lebih luas setelah persetujuan regulasi dan kapasitas produksi mencukupi.

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: Di atas kertas, ini adalah contoh langka dari perusahaan farmasi yang bergerak cepat untuk menyelaraskan harga dengan kebutuhan kesehatan masyarakat daripada menunggu bertahun-tahun hingga kompetisi generik memaksa perubahan tersebut.

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## Di Mana Peluncuran Mengalami Hambatan

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, menurut dokter dan pejabat kesehatan yang terlibat dalam distribusi awal, situasinya tidak merata.

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: Beberapa klinik di negara-negara peserta melaporkan rak-rak yang penuh dengan suntikan tersebut dan siap untuk mendaftarkan pasien.

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: Yang lain mengatakan mereka diberitahu untuk mengharapkan pengiriman baru pada bulan November, sehingga penyedia layanan tidak dapat memberikan jadwal pasti kepada pasien dan, dalam beberapa kasus, tidak dapat memulai pengobatan pasien baru sama sekali.

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: Petugas kesehatan menggambarkan campuran penyebab: kapasitas manufaktur global yang terbatas untuk jenis suntikan yang benar-benar baru, proses persetujuan regulasi yang bergerak dengan kecepatan berbeda dari satu negara ke negara lain, dan kompleksitas logistik dalam mendistribusikan produk yang sensitif terhadap suhu di seluruh sistem kesehatan dengan tingkat infrastruktur yang sangat berbeda.

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: Tidak satu pun dari masalah ini yang tidak biasa dalam peluncuran obat global — tetapi masalah ini berbenturan dengan ekspektasi yang sangat tinggi untuk obat yang data uji cobanya menunjukkan dapat secara berarti mengubah lintasan infeksi HIV baru.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Waktu Sangat Penting

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: Para advokat kesehatan masyarakat mencatat bahwa penundaan bukanlah hal yang netral.

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: Setiap bulan sebuah klinik tanpa pasokan adalah bulan di mana orang-orang yang mungkin telah memulai pencegahan justru tidak mendapatkannya, mengandalkan pil harian yang efektif tetapi lebih sulit untuk dipertahankan bagi banyak orang dalam jangka waktu yang lama.

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: Organisasi kesehatan internasional telah vokal tentang keinginan agar peluncuran awal menjangkau negara dan populasi yang paling terkena dampak HIV secepat mungkin, dengan alasan bahwa akses awal yang ditargetkan dengan baik dapat memiliki efek luar biasa pada penularan dari waktu ke waktu.

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: Gilead dan mitra distribusinya secara umum mengakui bahwa meningkatkan manufaktur dan logistik untuk produk yang pertama dari jenisnya membutuhkan waktu, dan telah menunjuk pada rencana ekspansi yang dimaksudkan untuk menutup kesenjangan antar negara dalam beberapa bulan mendatang.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang Lebih Besar

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: Peluncuran Lenacapavir diawasi dengan ketat bukan hanya sebagai kisah kesehatan masyarakat tetapi sebagai kasus uji tentang seberapa cepat industri dapat bergerak ketika sebuah perusahaan berkomitmen pada penetapan harga tanpa keuntungan di pasar berpenghasilan rendah.

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: Jika rantai pasokan membaik dalam beberapa bulan mendatang, para advokat mengatakan itu bisa menjadi model untuk peluncuran obat di masa depan.

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: Jika kesenjangan berlanjut hingga tahun depan, ini berisiko menjadi contoh lain dari terobosan medis menjanjikan yang tiba secara tidak merata — tersedia secara teori jauh sebelum tersedia dalam praktik.

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, jawabannya kemungkinan bervariasi dari klinik ke klinik.

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: Beberapa pasien di negara yang memenuhi syarat bisa mendapatkan janji temu untuk lenacapavir bulan ini.

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: Yang lain diminta untuk memeriksa kembali setelah tahun baru memasuki tahap akhir, berharap pasokan mengejar sains.

segments.tr: Pembaca yang memiliki pertanyaan tentang pilihan pencegahan HIV harus berkonsultasi dengan penyedia layanan kesehatan yang berkualifikasi.*

ja.title: 1回の投与で6か月、10か国：世界最高のHIV予防薬がそれを必要とするすべての人に行き渡らない理由

segments.src: ## A Breakthrough Drug Meets a Familiar Bottleneck
segments.tr: ## 画期的な新薬が直面するおなじみのボトルネック

segments.src: For decades, HIV prevention has meant daily pills, regular clinic visits, and the kind of routine that's easy to fall off of.
segments.tr: 何十年もの間、HIV予防とは毎日の服薬、定期的なクリニックへの受診、そして脱落しやすいルーティンを意味していました。

segments.src: Lenacapavir, the twice-yearly injectable developed by Gilead Sciences, was supposed to change that math entirely.
segments.tr: ギリアド・サイエンシズ社が開発した年2回投与の注射薬レナカパビル（Lenacapavir）は、その構図を完全に変えるはずでした。

segments.src: Two shots a year, near-complete protection in clinical trials, and a level of convenience that public health researchers have called one of the most significant advances in HIV prevention in a generation.
segments.tr: 年に2回の注射、臨床試験におけるほぼ完全な予防効果、そして公衆衛生の研究者たちが「一世代におけるHIV予防の最も重要な進歩の一つ」と呼ぶほどの利便性です。

segments.src: The catch isn't the science.
segments.tr: 問題は科学の側にはありません。

segments.src: It's getting the drug into arms.
segments.tr: その薬を実際に患者の腕に届けることなのです。

segments.src: ## What Gilead Promised
segments.tr: ## ギリアドが約束したこと

segments.src: Under pressure from global health advocates and in partnership with international health organizations, Gilead agreed to supply lenacapavir at no profit to a group of low- and middle-income countries where HIV rates remain highest, particularly across parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
segments.tr: グローバルヘルスのアドボケート（擁護者）からの圧力と国際保健機関とのパートナーシップのもと、ギリアド社は特にサブサハラアフリカの一部をはじめとするHIV感染率が最も高い低・中所得国のグループに対し、無利益（原価）でレナカパビルを供給することに合意しました。

segments.src: The company also licensed generic manufacturers to produce lower-cost versions for broader distribution once regulatory approvals and production capacity catch up.
segments.tr: 同社はまた、規制当局の承認と生産能力が追いつき次第、より広範な普及のために低価格版を製造できるよう、ジェネリック医薬品メーカーにもライセンスを供与しました。

segments.src: On paper, it was a rare example of a pharmaceutical company moving quickly to align pricing with public health need rather than waiting years for generic competition to force the issue.
segments.tr: 書面の上では、製薬会社がジェネリック医薬品との競争によって強制されるのを何年も待つのではなく、公衆衛生上のニーズに合わせて迅速に価格設定を調整した稀有な例でした。

segments.src: ## Where the Rollout Is Stalling
segments.tr: ## 普及（ロールアウト）が停滞している場所

segments.src: In practice, according to clinicians and health officials involved in early distribution, the picture has been uneven.
segments.tr: 初期の普及に関与した臨床医や保健当局者によると、実際にはその状況は不均一です。

segments.src: Some clinics in participating countries report shelves stocked with the injectable and ready to enroll patients.
segments.tr: 参加国のいくつかのクリニックでは、注射薬が棚に補充され、患者を受け入れる準備ができていると報告されています。

segments.src: Others say they've been told to expect shipments only as late as November, leaving providers unable to give patients a firm timeline and, in some cases, unable to start new patients on the drug at all.
segments.tr: 一方で、出荷は11月まで見込めないと告げられているクリニックもあり、医療従事者は患者に確実なスケジュールを伝えることができず、場合によっては新薬の投与を全く開始できない状態にあります。

segments.src: Health workers describe a mix of causes: limited global manufacturing capacity for a genuinely new type of injectable, regulatory approval processes that move at different speeds from country to country, and the logistical complexity of distributing a temperature-sensitive product across health systems with very different levels of infrastructure.
segments.tr: 医療従事者らは、その原因が複合的であると説明しています。まったく新しいタイプの注射薬に対する世界的な製造能力の限界、国ごとにスピードが異なる規制承認プロセス、そしてインフラのレベルが大きく異なる保健医療システムを通じて温度管理が必要な製品を流通させるという物流上の複雑さです。

segments.src: None of these are unusual problems in global drug rollouts — but they are colliding with unusually high expectations for a drug that trial data suggested could meaningfully bend the trajectory of new HIV infections.
segments.tr: これらはいずれも世界的な医薬品普及において珍しい問題ではありません。しかし、臨床試験データがHIV新規感染の軌道を意味のある形で変えられることを示唆した新薬に対する、異例なほど高い期待と衝突しています。

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Matters
segments.tr: ## なぜタイミングが重要なのか

segments.src: Public health advocates note that delays are not neutral.
segments.tr: 公衆衛生のアドボケートたちは、遅れは単なる時間損失にとどまらないと指摘しています。

segments.src: Every month a clinic goes without supply is a month where people who might have started prevention instead go without it, relying on daily pills that are effective but harder to sustain for many people over long periods.
segments.tr: クリニックに供給がない毎月は、予防を開始できたはずの人々が予防なしで過ごすことを意味し、効果的ではあっても多くの人にとって長期間の継続が難しい毎日の服薬に頼らざるを得なくなります。

segments.src: International health organizations have been vocal about wanting the initial rollout to reach the countries and populations most affected by HIV as quickly as possible, arguing that early, well-targeted access can have outsized effects on transmission over time.
segments.tr: 国際保健機関は、初期の普及が最もHIVの影響を受けている国や人々に可能な限り迅速に行き渡ることを強く求めており、早期で的を絞ったアクセスが長期的には感染拡大防止に非常に大きな効果をもたらすと主張しています。

segments.src: Gilead and its distribution partners have generally acknowledged that scaling manufacturing and logistics for a first-of-its-kind product takes time, and have pointed to expansion plans intended to close gaps between countries in the coming months.
segments.tr: ギリアドとその流通パートナーは、これまでにない初の製品の製造と物流の規模拡大には時間がかかることを概ね認めており、今後数か月で国ごとの格差を埋めるための拡大計画を示しています。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 全体像

segments.src: Lenacapavir's rollout is being closely watched not just as a public health story but as a test case for how quickly the industry can move when a company commits to no-profit pricing in lower-income markets.
segments.tr: レナカパビルの普及は、単なる公衆衛生の話題としてだけでなく、企業が低所得国市場での無利益価格設定を約束した際に、業界がいかに迅速に動けるかというケーススタディとしても注視されています。

segments.src: If the supply chain smooths out in the coming months, advocates say it could become a model for future drug launches.
segments.tr: 今後数か月でサプライチェーンが円滑になれば、将来の医薬品新発売のモデルケースになり得るとアドボケートは語ります。

segments.src: If the gaps persist into next year, it risks becoming another example of a promising medical breakthrough arriving unevenly — available in theory long before it's available in practice.
segments.tr: もしこの格差が来年まで続くようであれば、期待される医療の飛躍的進歩が不均一に届くという新たな例——理論上利用可能になってから実際に利用可能になるまでに長い時間がかかるというリスクに晒されます。

segments.src: For now, the answer likely varies clinic by clinic.
segments.tr: 今のところ、その答えはクリニックごとに異なる可能性が高いでしょう。

segments.src: Some patients in eligible countries can get an appointment for lenacapavir this month.
segments.tr: 対象国の幾人かの患者は、今月中にレナカパビルの予約を取ることができます。

segments.src: Others are being asked to check back after the new year begins its final stretch, hoping the supply catches up with the science.
segments.tr: 他の人々は、供給が科学に追いつくことを願いながら、新年が最後の追い込みに入った後に再度確認するよう求められています。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and does not constitute medical advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、医学的助言を構成するものではありません。

segments.src: Readers with questions about HIV prevention options should consult a qualified healthcare provider.*
segments.tr: HIV予防の選択肢に関する質問がある読者は、資格のある医療従事者に相談してください。*
